- Option B: 18:00 PT — that's 02:00 CET next day (we realize that's late for you)

If there's any middle-ground suggestion from your side (e.g., EU morning / our late afternoon) that keeps it under 19:00 CET, that would be ideal. Also: can you confirm whether you'll record and whether someone from Redwood can run the demo twice on the same week if needed (we have folks who can't make the first slot)?

Attaching our mutual action plan and current list of attendees.

Thanks,
